summary: IceCure Medical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with exhibits for a special general meeting of shareholders scheduled for August 6, 2026. The meeting seeks shareholder approval of an amendment to outstanding Series B and Series C warrants issued to Armistice Capital Master Fund Ltd. on March 27, 2026, covering up to 266,666 ordinary shares at an exercise price of $16.50 per share. The filing is a routine proxy statement and notice for a shareholder vote on warrant terms; no merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or other special-situation event is present. This is a standard corporate governance filing for a warrant amendment approval.
